description: K₄Na₂FeH₃F₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to one H and eleven F atoms. The K-H bond length is 2.81 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.22 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 13-coordinate geometry to two H and eleven F atoms. There is one shorter (2.69 Å) and one longer (2.72 Å) K-H bond length. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.28 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 4°. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and four longer (2.31 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-4°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.29 Å. Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-4°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-1.98 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two K and two F atoms. There is one shorter (1.14 Å) and one longer (1.16 Å) H-F bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent K and two equivalent F atoms. Both H-F bond lengths are 1.15 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Fe atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four K, one Na, and one Fe atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Fe atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three K, one Na, and one H atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four K, one Na, and one H atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three K, one Na, and one H atom.
